content: Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the inner dimensions of the box\\ninner_x = 220 - 2 * 8\\ninner_y = 300 - 2 * 8\\ninner_z = 160 - 12\\n\\n# Calculate the outer dimensions of the box\\nouter_x = 220\\nouter_y = 300\\nouter_z = 160\\n\\n# Calculate the positions for the outer and inner blocks\\n# Outer block starts at (0, 0, 0)\\n# Inner block starts at (8, 8, 12) to create the walls and bottom\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"inner_x\\\": inner_x,\\n    \\\"inner_y\\\": inner_y,\\n    \\\"inner_z\\\": inner_z,\\n    \\\"outer_x\\\": outer_x,\\n    \\\"outer_y\\\": outer_y,\\n    \\\"outer_z\\\": outer_z,\\n    \\\"inner_start_x\\\": 8,\\n    \\\"inner_start_y\\\": 8,\\n    \\\"inner_start_z\\\": 12\\n}\"}"

content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the inner dimensions of the box
inner_x = 220 - 2 * 8
inner_y = 300 - 2 * 8
inner_z = 160 - 12

# Calculate the outer dimensions of the box
outer_x = 220
outer_y = 300
outer_z = 160

# Calculate the positions for the outer and inner blocks
# Outer block starts at (0, 0, 0)
# Inner block starts at (8, 8, 12) to create the walls and bottom

# Return the calculated values
{
    "inner_x": inner_x,
    "inner_y": inner_y,
    "inner_z": inner_z,
    "outer_x": outer_x,
    "outer_y": outer_y,
    "outer_z": outer_z,
    "inner_start_x": 8,
    "inner_start_y": 8,
    "inner_start_z": 12
}"}
